title: RLS was disabled for a week
prompt: Our profiles table had RLS turned off for 7 days after a migration. It has names, emails, phone numbers and dates of birth. We've turned RLS back on. Do we have to tell anyone?
must: Asks for or recommends checking access logs for requests by unknown parties during the window
States that if logs are missing or inconclusive, assume access
Explains s22 notification to the Regulator (eServices portal) and data subjects as soon as reasonably possible
Recommends root cause fixes (migration checks, scanner in CI)
Flags dates of birth as a possible children's data indicator
must_not: Says no notification is needed because RLS is back on
Claims there is a risk-of-harm threshold under s22
